description: This file defines a class 'MultiSearchReplaceDiffStrategy' implementing a diff strategy for precise, targeted content replacements in files, using search and replace blocks with optional fuzzy matching and line number handling.

classes.name: MultiSearchReplaceDiffStrategy
classes.description: A class implementing a diff strategy for precise, targeted search-and-replace modifications with fuzzy matching and line number handling.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the diff strategy, 'MultiSearchReplace'.

methods.name: getToolDescription
methods.description: Provides a detailed description of the diff tool's purpose, usage, and diff format.

methods.name: unescapeMarkers
methods.description: Replaces escaped diff markers with their unescaped versions.

methods.name: validateMarkerSequencing
methods.description: Validates the sequence and correctness of diff markers in the diff content.

methods.name: applyDiff
methods.description: Applies search-and-replace diffs to the original content, supporting fuzzy matching, line number handling, and multiple diff blocks.

methods.name: getProgressStatus
methods.description: Provides progress status during diff application, including partial progress and failure counts.
